title: Move-loop sites
statement: Let a move-loop site be one of the following finitely many operations: copy $n$ into $a$; copy a product from $T$ into $P$, with a Boolean parameter; copy $P$ into $w$; copy either $U$ or $V$ into the endpoint stack, according to a Boolean parameter; copy the doubled phase stack from $T$ into $SP$, with a Boolean parameter; copy $M$ into $V$; copy $V$ into $U$; copy the popped endpoint $E$ into $V$; move the last endpoint-stack digit into $E$, with a Boolean parameter; copy the remaining stack from $T$ into $SE$, with a Boolean parameter; copy $V$ into $M$; copy $E$ into $V$; copy $E$ into $U$; copy $U$ into $M$; or copy $E$ into $U$.
hypotheses_covered: The move site is one of the listed constructors
Boolean parameters are available on the constructors that carry them
